steps.notes: Initial artifact was real and verified. Observation after inspection: it worked, but routine follow-ups required Edit/Delete only, making the daily follow-up loop clunky.

steps.prompt_exact: The first version works, but the cards only have Edit/Delete, so using it every day would still mean reopening the full form for routine follow-ups. Add quick card actions to mark followed up today, reschedule +1 day or +7 days, and show a small last-contacted timestamp; keep local storage/CSV export and return the complete updated single HTML file.
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned a complete updated HTML file adding quick follow-up and reschedule card actions plus last-contacted display/sort while retaining the original CRM features.
